usedFor: Each Liliphant meeting summary is saved as a note on the person in HubSpot.

bestTemplate.name: “New Analyzed Meeting Summary” in Liliphant, then “Add Notes to Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: The summary is worth keeping, saved as a dated note found by ID or email.

watchOut: “New Analyzed Meeting Summary” polls, so HubSpot notes arrive after the next check.
